annotations.title: Add an email to a customer

description: Add an email address to an existing customer, optionally as their primary address. Shopmonkey: POST /v3/customer/:id/email.

locationId.description: The shop location id (see shopmonkey_get_current_user for the key's own location).

primary.description: Make this the customer's primary email.

subscribed.description: Whether the customer receives messages at this address.

name: shopmonkey_add_customer_email
title: Add an email to a customer
